FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At SmartCell Solutions, we specialize in retail sales and service of cellular phones and accessories. Our operations include offering a comprehensive range of the latest smartphone models from authorized manufacturers, along with accessories such as cases, chargers, and earbuds. We also provide repair services for common issues like screen replacements and battery servicing, ensuring all repairs are conducted by our skilled technicians who adhere to strict quality control measures. Our store is equipped with robust inventory management systems to track stock levels and prevent loss, and we maintain clear and customer-friendly warranty policies for our products and services. With a commitment to compliance and customer satisfaction, we actively review our practices to meet all relevant data protection regulations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities related to unresolved data breaches, nor does it sell counterfeit, untested, or grey-market devices. Additionally, we confirm that there have been no incidents of battery fires or device-related injuries associated with our operations, and we maintain robust inventory management and theft prevention controls.
